scaleBeatText: A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands walks away from Haven. They don't look back.

With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
📺 The billing says EXTREME RISK — almost nobody walks away from this one.

🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

The table is green felt under white light. Across it: Vex of the Ninth Ledger — seventeen limbs, zero losses on camera, and a smile like a tax form.
Nobody's beaten Vex on camera. The veterans just say "don't think at the table." They won't say why.
📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.

📯 The Red Table's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

◈ SYSTEM: "33. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,000 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

◈ The realm came apart — no polity answers to Haven now, and Haven is a free fire again. National and global no longer describe this village. The climb starts over.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.
🗣️ Patricia to Serafin, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
bindingBeatText: ◈ SYSTEM: "You are not the head of this. That is the point. A realm of 5 fires — and The Red Table wants Haven's oath. The audience LOVES a binding."
